messages:
Sienna Tran: Hi everyone — I’m Sienna, starting on Growth today! Quick q: who should I ping for laptop/MDM access and Slack perms? Also curious about any must-try snacks in the office. Fun fact: I bake sourdough and have a tortoise named Mango. :tortoise:

Alex Gomez: Welcome Sienna!! 🎉 I’m Alex (Growth). Stoked to have you. Ping Jen for hardware and me for any ramp questions. We’ll do a 1:1 later.

Cora Li: hey Sienna, I’m Cora on growth ops — I’ll be your onboarding buddy. For devices Jen handles the requests, and Samir handles VPN/ssh. Also we have a #snacks channel where people vote on shipments. Salty or sweet?

Jen (People Ops): Hi Sienna — welcome! I just created the laptop ticket. Expect shipping in ~2 business days. Welcome kit includes stickers + a ramen bowl. If you have a device preference (M1/M2 or Linux) reply here.

Samir Desai: @Sienna Tran add your preferred email to the ticket and I’ll pre-provision VPN and SSH access. Quick dev note: once you have a machine run `./dev/setup.sh` from the repo root to bootstrap common deps. Ping me if you hit permission errors.

MDM Bot: Automated: To enroll your device, visit https://mdm.example.com/enroll and use your company email. Contact Samir or Jen if enrollment fails.

Alex Gomez: Also — team lunch on Friday, you in? We do a ramen outing sometimes if folks are around.

Cora Li: Confirmed — I’ll send a 3pm buddy walkthrough Zoom invite for today. I’ll also add you to #snacks and #growth-ops.

Sienna Tran: Thanks all — salty snacks for me! Looking forward to the 3pm walkthrough. Mango says hi 🐢

Alex Gomez: Perfect. Quick FYI: our first-week checklist lives in the handbook under "Onboarding > Growth". If anything missing ping me or Cora.

Cora Li: Sent Zoom + calendar. Welcome aboard! :party_popper:
